title: Targeting ID2 to augment doxorubicin antitumor efficacy and enhance antibacterial defense without neutropenia.
authors: Luo, Xinyu; Zheng, Shuyin; Liu, Biao; Gong, Xue; Zhao, Changhao; Zhang, Xingya; Wu, Minna; Zheng, Miao; Lin, Bin; Zhong, Genshen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ID2小分子拮抗剂ID2-iNeu的促中性粒细胞分化与抗肿瘤活性，虽含分子对接模拟，但核心是药物功能与动物实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，仅边缘相关。
abstract: This study identifies and characterizes ID2-iNeu, a novel antagonist of inhibitor of differentiation-2 (ID2), which exhibits dual bioactivities in promoting neutrophil differentiation and potentiating antitumor efficacy while ameliorating chemotherapy-induced neutropenia. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis verified the specific binding of ID2-iNeu to human ID2 protein. In vivo experiments in C57BL/6 mice demonstrated that ID2-iNeu markedly elevated neutrophil counts in peripheral blood and spleen, a phenotypic effect not observed for the well-established ID inhibitors AGX51 and AK778-XXMU. In a murine peritonitis model, ID2-iNeu improved bacterial clearance more efficiency, which was closely correlated with the increased abundance of neutrophils. In the B16 melanoma xenograft model, ID2-iNeu exerted potent antitumor activity and synergistically enhanced the therapeutic efficacy of doxorubicin (ADM). Notably, single-agent ADM treatment significantly reduced peripheral neutrophil levels, whereas combinatorial administration with ID2-iNeu effectively reversed ADM-induced neutropenia without exacerbating ADM-associated cardiotoxicity. Bone marrow RNA-sequencing analysis revealed that ID2-iNeu globally remodels the transcriptional profile of hematopoietic differentiation, modulating core signaling pathways (including IGF, PDGF, and Hippo cascades) and key transcription factor families (bHLH, Homeobox, and zf-C2H2), thereby facilitating neutrophil lineage commitment. Molecular docking simulations further revealed that a unique cation-pi interaction formed between ID2-iNeu and the Lys58 residue of ID2 protein, which accounts for its distinct functional properties, distinguishing it from the other two ID-targeting compounds AGX51 and AK778-XXMU. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that ID2-iNeu serves as a promising therapeutic candidate for simultaneously alleviating chemotherapy-induced neutropenia and augmenting antitumor therapeutic responses.
abstract_zh: 本研究鉴定并表征了ID2-iNeu，一种新型的抑制剂分化-2（ID2）拮抗剂，其具有促进中性粒细胞分化和增强抗肿瘤疗效的双重生物活性，同时改善化疗诱导的中性粒细胞减少症。表面等离子体共振（SPR）分析验证了ID2-iNeu与人ID2蛋白的特异性结合。在C57BL/6小鼠中的体内实验表明，ID2-iNeu显著提高了外周血和脾脏中的中性粒细胞计数，而这一表型效应在已确立的ID抑制剂AGX51和AK778-XXMU中未观察到。在小鼠腹膜炎模型中，ID2-iNeu更有效地改善了细菌清除率，这与中性粒细胞丰度的增加密切相关。在B16黑色素瘤异种移植模型中，ID2-iNeu发挥了强效的抗肿瘤活性，并协同增强了阿霉素（ADM）的治疗效果。值得注意的是，单药ADM治疗显著降低了外周血中性粒细胞水平，而ID2-iNeu的联合给药有效逆转了ADM诱导的中性粒细胞减少症，且未加重ADM相关的心脏毒性。骨髓RNA测序分析揭示，ID2-iNeu全局重塑了造血分化的转录谱，调节核心信号通路（包括IGF、PDGF和Hippo级联）及关键转录因子家族（bHLH、Homeobox和zf-C2H2），从而促进中性粒细胞谱系定向。分子对接模拟进一步揭示，ID2-iNeu与ID2蛋白的Lys58残基之间形成独特的阳离子-π相互作用，这解释了其独特的功能特性，使其区别于其他两种ID靶向化合物AGX51和AK778-XXMU。综上所述，这些发现表明ID2-iNeu作为同时缓解化疗诱导的中性粒细胞减少症和增强抗肿瘤治疗反应的有前景的治疗候选药物。
